description: Build an unsigned create-multisig tx. createKey is a fresh random pubkey the agent generates; it must co-sign the tx (two signers: creator + createKey). Returns the derived multisig + vault addresses, base64 v0 tx, and lastValidBlockHeight.

createKey.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

creator.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

members.description: The multisig members. Omit permissions to grant all three.

key.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

permissions.description: What this member is allowed to do. All three are independent.

execute.description: May execute a proposal once it reaches threshold.

threshold.description: Approvals required to execute a proposal. Must not exceed the member count.

name: solknife_multisig_create_build
